Discover words worth keeping with Quoter.

Swipe through inspiring quotes and save the ones that resonate. Build your personal Library, organize your favorites into collections, and find the words you want to revisit with search.

Whether you’re looking for motivation, creative inspiration, or a quiet moment of reflection, find something that speaks to you—and keep it close.

quotes.text:
I've been working on an app called Quoter, designed to deliver daily inspirational quotes from renowned authors and thinkers.

With Quoter, you can swipe right to like a quote or left to dislike it, making it easy to engage with content that resonates with you. You can save your favorite quotes and organize them into custom collections. Registered users can also add their own quotes. Sharing quotes with friends or on social media is straightforward. Plus, registered users can back up their quotes to keep them safe, even if you reinstall the app.

I created Quoter because I wanted a simple, customizable way to get daily inspiration. There are a lot of quote apps out there, but I felt they lacked interactive features and user-friendly design. Quoter introduces a swipe feature, adding a playful element to the browsing experience. The focus on simplicity ensures that using Quoter is straightforward and intuitive.

Quoter is currently available in the USA, Canada, Australia, Ireland, UK, and New Zealand.

You can download it on iOS:

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/quoter-daily-inspiration/id6479527672

and Android:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.alexfeller.quoter

I'd love to get your feedback and hear any suggestions for improvement. Thanks!
